dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-back toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse distribution of darker grey clusters across the dorsal surface with moderate spatial frequency.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between darker pigmented regions and the primary slate-grey baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, high-contrast longitudinal white linear mark along the central dorsal ridge and several smaller light-colored punctate marks on the mid-dorsal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a prominent longitudinal white linear mark on the dorsal ridge and scattered irregular light-colored epidermal spots.
